mapper.select: SELECT id, seat_id, room_id, user_id, book_date, start_time, end_time, status, checkin_at, leave_at, version, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM seat_booking WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_date = #{bookDate} AND status IN ('BOOKED', 'CHECKED_IN', 'LEAVING') ORDER BY start_time
SELECT id, seat_id, room_id, user_id, book_date, start_time, end_time, status, checkin_at, leave_at, version, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM seat_booking WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seat_booking (seat_id, room_id, user_id, book_date, start_time, end_time, status, version, remark) VALUES (#{seatId}, #{roomId}, #{userId}, #{bookDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, 1, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE seat_booking SET status = 'CHECKED_IN', checkin_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'BOOKED'
UPDATE seat_booking SET status = 'LEAVING', leave_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CHECKED_IN'
UPDATE seat_booking SET status = 'CHECKED_IN', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'LEAVING'
UPDATE seat_booking SET status = 'EXPIRED', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'BOOKED'
UPDATE seat_booking SET status = 'EXPIRED', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'LEAVING'
UPDATE seat_booking SET status = 'FINISHED', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('CHECKED_IN', 'LEAVING')
